property_summary: The transfer function either transfers to all addresses in the array or reverts before any transfer occurs, never successfully transferring to only a subset.
When transfer completes successfully, the entire _tos array must have been processed (i.e., the call must have performed all transfers or none, without early exit after the first element).
When transfer succeeds, it processes all elements of _tos; when it reverts, it processes none.
When transfer succeeds, the number of calls made to the token contract equals the length of _tos; when it reverts, the number of calls is zero.
When transfer succeeds, exactly one complete iteration of the loop is performed, so the token contract sees exactly one call regardless of _tos length.
